name: io.github.nikolas-sapa/bounty-radar
description: Search real, funded GitHub developer bounties — scam-farm clones filtered, competition scored. Pay-per-call $0.01 USDC via x402 on Base. No account, no API key.

environmentVariables.name: PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Base wallet private key (with a little USDC) used to pay the $0.01/call x402 fee. Stays local.

environmentVariables.name: BOUNTY_RADAR_URL
environmentVariables.description: Override the API endpoint (defaults to the hosted service).
